item.title: Indianapolis Clowns make history at Banana Ball World Tour stop in Tallahassee
item.description: The Indianapolis Clowns returned to baseball for the first time since the late 1980s, winning game two of the Banana Ball World Tour in Tallahassee.

item.title: Dunkin' surprises local kids with tickets to Saturday night's sold-out game
item.description: Players from the Savannah Bananas and Texas Tailgaters took over a Tallahassee Dunkin’ Saturday morning, serving fans and interacting with community members who couldn’t snag tickets to the game.

item.title: Savannah Bananas sell out Doak Campbell Stadium for Banana Ball World Tour stop in Tallahassee
